predictions.certainty: Seed entry is at near-parity. Exit is at premium.
predictions.claim: By end-2027, the cumulative T1-to-unregulated funding premium widens from 2.12x (2026) to at least 2.30x at Series D+ in the four target markets.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if Series D+ cumulative funding premium ≥ 2.30× on the 2027 re-query. Resolved NO if < 2.30×.

predictions.certainty: Regulation is the sieve for defensible returns at every stage.
predictions.claim: By end-2028, the T1+T2 share of the four-market 19,416-company dataset re-query holds at or above 33%.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if T1+T2 share of the four-market 19,416 universe is ≥ 33% on the 2028-12-31 re-query. Resolved NO if < 33%.

predictions.certainty: Regulation absorbs capital at an accelerating rate.
predictions.claim: By end-2028, regulated companies' share of four-market Series C funding holds at or above 60%.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if regulated (T1+T2) share of four-market Series C funding ≥ 60% on the 2028 re-query (today 63%). Resolved NO if < 60%.

predictions.certainty: A global strategic-acquirer buyer set exists and is active.
predictions.claim: By end-2028, at least two additional named acquisitions of developed-APAC regulated-technology companies by NA or EMEA strategic acquirers close at EV at or above $100M.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if 2+ named acquisitions meeting the EV threshold close by 2028-12-31. Each must have a primary-source filing trail.

predictions.certainty: Developed APAC sets frontier regulation in the Necessity categories.
predictions.claim: By end-2028, at least three of the thirty-four in-flight regulations crystallise as enacted operational frameworks.
predictions.source: Public regulator publications across AU, JP, NZ, SG
predictions.resolution_criteria: Resolved YES if 3+ of the 34 in-flight regulations have published their final operational compliance documentation by 2028-12-31. Resolved NO if ≤ 2.
